description: A Minecraft mod that allows you to access calculator, notepad, crafting list and tools that you can create your own rule.

mods.name: Player Workspace
mods.description: An all-in-one player workspace with calculator, notepad, crafting guide, and tools.

releases.notes:
## Features

### Calculator
- Expression evaluation with parentheses and operators (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`)
- On-screen buttons for quick input
- History of past calculations (persistent across sessions)

### Notepad
- Create, edit, and delete notes in-game
- Titles and content are saved automatically
- Configurable max notes and note length (via ModMenu)

### Crafting Guide
- Search any item by name or ID
- Pin items to your HUD for quick reference
- Multiple pinned items shown stacked on-screen
- Configurable pin position (via ModMenu)

### Tools
- Custom calculation tools using formulas with `x` as input
- Built-in examples: Nether/Overworld distance, stack size calculator, block/ingot conversion, minutes to seconds
- Test formulas live before saving
- Wiki with usage instructions
